purpose: A relationship target must be spelled the way the lane spells its own symbols. The differential oracle derives truth from the same rules the analyzer runs, so a spelling BOTH sides fabricate identically (php's `$o->{'lit'}` publishing the string literal `'lit'`) is invisible to every per-edge gate and to the M59 line oracle: agreement is not evidence when both sides compute the same wrong answer. This census asks the prior question per lane, calibrating against the lane's OWN symbol alphabet measured at runtime over real corpora rather than a hardcoded per-language character set.
boundary: Measures SPELLING, not RESOLUTION: a well-spelled target that resolves to nothing is the differential's finding, not this one's. `sampleTargets` is a BOUNDED sample (120 distinct per lane) with `distinctTargets` the true count beside it, so the artifact stays auditable without carrying every target. Two classes: `literal` (the whole target is a quoted string or a bare number — no calibration needed, no false positives possible) and `punctuation` (a non-alphanumeric character occurring in none of the lane's own symbol names; alphanumerics are excluded so a character absent from a 40-file draw cannot convict). The alphabet is a sample of the lane's own symbols, so a lane under MIN_SYMBOLS distinct names reads `underdetermined` and is not adjudicated. Conventions with a separator are DECLARED in validation/m60/target-spelling-register.json scoped to (lang, relationshipType, char) with a written reason; nothing is tolerated by an implicit allowlist in this file.
